title: Ethereum's Roadmap, Simplified: What Changes Next and Why
description:
Ethereum’s core protocol development roadmap can feel hard to understand - so this talk breaks it down in plain, beginner-friendly language. Attendees will learn what to be excited about in the short, medium, and long term, and how the roadmap actually comes together.

We’ll also address common concerns - like the idea that the roadmap “keeps changing” - and explain how core protocol work is funded.

As a core contributor to Protocol Guild (a funding mechanism for Ethereum’s core protocol), I’ll have the unique ability to share practical context and up-to-date perspectives from direct collaboration with core developers to make the roadmap clear and accurate.
